title: sqlparse: Bug report (issue #809) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is sqlparse (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #809) from a user of this library:

> `sqlparse.split()` breaks a single statement apart when it contains a `BEGIN ... END` block with semicolons inside, for example a `WITH FUNCTION ... BEGIN DECLARE ...; RETURN ...; END SELECT ...` query or a `CREATE PROCEDURE` body. The semicolons inside the block are part of the statement; splitting should only happen after the whole statement.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
